turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Monday starting off in Portland? Did you and Grace have a good weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! The weekend was nice and relaxing, but today has been a bit of a rush. I actually skipped breakfast today because I was running so late this morning. Usually I have my eggs and toast, but there just wasn't time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no! After your nutritionist suggested getting more protein at breakfast, skipping it entirely must feel like a rough start. Hopefully you managed to grab a quick coffee or something?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I grabbed a quick black coffee at school, but that was about it. It was definitely a one-off exception just because of the morning chaos. I'll get back to the usual routine tomorrow.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense. Some days are just like that! Did the rest of your school day go any smoother at the science department?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thankfully, yes. Once I got through the morning rush, things settled down. I even managed to squeeze in a workout after work—I did some gym weights.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! It's great to hear you can do gym weights now without any trouble, especially after that lower back strain a while back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly. The back feels completely fine, so lifting has been great. I'm taking a break from tennis today, though, just to give myself a rest.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move. Resting is just as important. Do you and Grace have any low-key plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not much, just hanging out with Olive. I think I'm going to put on some sitcom reruns on TV and just unwind.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sitcom reruns sound perfect for a Monday evening. Are you watching them on that new streaming service you signed up for?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, actually! They have a great selection of old favorites, so it's super easy to just put something familiar on and zone out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Familiar shows are the best for winding down. I hope you get a chance to relax and have a much more peaceful morning tomorrow!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm definitely planning on a better night's sleep tonight. Talk to you tomorrow!
